tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Get an executable MERX quote when resource, amount, fixed-grid duration and target_address are supplied. The response names the quoted provider. Without all four fields, returns raw provider observations labelled as non-executable analytics.

resource.description: Filter by resource type. Omit for all.

duration.description: Executable duration/filter in seconds on the fixed grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours. Omit it to see every raw provider tier; raw analytics may include longer non-orderable observations.

amount.description: Exact resource amount for an executable quote.

target_address.description: TRON recipient address for an executable quote.

tools.name: get_best_price
tools.description: Get the exact executable MERX quote and quoted provider. Requires resource, amount, a fixed-grid duration, and target_address.

duration.description: Exact rental duration in seconds on the fixed grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours.

tools.name: analyze_prices
tools.description: Market price analysis with trends and recommendations. No auth required.

resource.description: Filter by resource type. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Historical price snapshots. No auth required.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Show raw provider observations for market analytics. This tool does not identify an executable provider; use get_best_price for an executable quote.

resource.description: Filter by resource type. Omit for all.

tools.name: estimate_transaction_cost
tools.description: Estimate cost of a TRON transaction BEFORE sending. Aliases: estimate_cost, calculate_cost, transaction_cost, energy_cost, transfer_cost. Calculate exactly how much energy, bandwidth, and TRX a TRON transaction will cost before sending it. Use this to answer questions like "how much does a USDT transfer cost?" or "what will it cost me to send 100 USDT to address X?". Returns: energy units needed, bandwidth needed, TRX cost if you burn directly, and TRX cost if you rent energy from Merx (typically 70-80% cheaper). Supports trc20_transfer (e.g. USDT/USDC), trc20_approve, trx_transfer, and custom contract calls. No auth required.

tools.name: check_address_resources
tools.description: Check energy, bandwidth, and TRX balance for any TRON address. No auth required.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Buy energy or bandwidth at the Merx market quote. Confirmed Merx funds and API key required; no commission.

amount.description: Amount of resource units (min 65000 for ENERGY, 1000 for BANDWIDTH).

duration_sec.description: Rental duration in seconds on the fixed market grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours.

target_address.description: TRON address to receive delegated resources.

max_price_sun.description: Optional offered price in SUN/unit. Below-current offers fail; equal or higher offers execute at the submitted price. Omit to use the current best price.

idempotency_key.description: Unique operation ID (1–200 characters). Reuse this exact value when retrying after a timeout or lost response.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get order status by UUID. Aliases: get_order_status, check_order, order_status, order_details, fetch_order. Check the status and fill details of an existing order by its UUID. Returns current status (PENDING/FILLING/FILLED/PARTIAL/FAILED/CANCELLED), fill amounts, provider used, on-chain delegation tx hash if delivered. Use this to poll order progress after creating an order. Auth required (API key).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List recent orders with optional status filter. Auth required.

limit.description: Max number of orders to return (default: 20).

tools.name: ensure_resources
tools.description: Declarative resource provisioning. Checks current resources on target address and purchases only what is missing. Auth required.

idempotency_key.description: Unique operation ID (1–200 characters). Reuse exactly this ID when retrying this operation.

target_address.description: TRON address to provision resources for.

energy_minimum.description: Minimum energy the address should have.

bandwidth_minimum.description: Minimum bandwidth the address should have.

duration_sec.description: Rental duration in seconds on the fixed market grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours (default: 3600).

tools.name: wait_for_delegation
tools.description: Block until an order reaches a terminal state (FILLED, PARTIAL, FAILED, or CANCELLED) by polling get_order at fixed intervals. Use this right after create_order when you need to confirm the energy/bandwidth has actually been delegated on-chain before sending the next transaction. Returns the final order details including the on-chain delegation tx hash. Auth required.

order_id.description: The order UUID returned by create_order.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum time to wait in seconds (default: 60, max: 300).

poll_interval_sec.description: How often to check status in seconds (default: 3, min: 1).

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get your Merx account balance (TRX, USDT, locked). Requires MERX_API_KEY.

tools.name: get_deposit_info
tools.description: Get your personal TRON address for TRX deposits. No memo is required. Requires MERX_API_KEY.

tools.name: get_transaction_history
tools.description: Get your Merx account transaction history. Requires MERX_API_KEY.

tools.name: explain_concept
tools.description: Explain a TRON or Merx concept in plain language. Hardcoded topics (exact match): energy, bandwidth, staking, delegation, sun_units, burn_vs_rent, merx_routing, provider_types. The lookup is fuzzy — substring matches also work, so "rent" finds "burn_vs_rent" and "providers" finds "provider_types". For topics outside this list (e.g. x402, stablecoins, gasfree), pick the closest hardcoded topic, or just answer the question yourself from the broader context — this tool only returns canned explanations of TRON resource economics.

topic.description: Topic to explain. Exact: energy, bandwidth, staking, delegation, sun_units, burn_vs_rent, merx_routing, provider_types. Fuzzy substrings (e.g. "rent", "providers") also work.

tools.name: suggest_duration
tools.description: Recommend a supported duration and return the executable MERX quote and quoted provider for a target address.

target_address.description: TRON recipient address required for an executable offer.

tools.name: calculate_savings
tools.description: Calculate savings from renting energy vs burning TRX. No authentication required.

target_address.description: TRON recipient address required for an executable MERX quote.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List all Merx providers with types, durations, and availability. No authentication required.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Inspect any TRON address. Aliases: check_address, get_address_info, get_wallet_info, address_info, account_status. Read the full on-chain state of ANY TRON address (does not have to be your own): TRX balance, free + delegated energy, free + delegated bandwidth, frozen TRX, account creation timestamp. Use this to check if an address has enough resources before sending a transaction, or to inspect any TRON wallet. No auth required, no API key needed.

tools.name: get_chain_parameters
tools.description: Get TRON network parameters (energy fee, bandwidth cost, etc.) with Merx price comparison. No auth required.

tools.name: convert_address

address.description: TRON address in base58 (T...) or hex (41...).

tools.name: transfer_trx

resource_operation_id.description: Optional stable ID for resource purchases. Reuse on retries; this does not make the token transfer itself idempotent.

tools.description: Transfer TRC-20 tokens with automatic energy optimization. Signs and broadcasts on-chain. Requires TRON_PRIVATE_KEY.

resource_operation_id.description: Optional stable ID for resource purchases. Reuse on retries; this does not make the token transfer itself idempotent.

token.description: Token symbol (USDT, USDC) or contract address.

tools.description: Approve TRC-20 spending allowance. Signs and broadcasts on-chain. Requires TRON_PRIVATE_KEY.

resource_operation_id.description: Optional stable ID for resource purchases. Reuse on retries; this does not make the token transfer itself idempotent.

tools.description: Get TRC-20 token metadata: name, symbol, decimals, total supply. No auth required.

tools.name: read_contract

tools.name: call_contract

resource_operation_id.description: Optional stable ID for resource purchases. Reuse on retries; this does not make the token transfer itself idempotent.

resource_operation_id.description: Optional stable ID for resource purchases. Reuse on retries; this does not make the token transfer itself idempotent.

from_token.description: Source token symbol (TRX, USDT, USDC, etc.)

amount.description: Amount of source token to swap

tools.name: get_token_price

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a new Merx account, generate an API key, and get deposit info. No auth needed.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to an existing Merx account. No MERX_API_KEY needed.

tools.name: set_api_key
tools.description: Set your Merx API key for this session. Unlocks all authenticated tools (trading, balance, orders). Use this if you already have an API key.

api_key.description: Your Merx API key (starts with sk_live_)

tools.name: set_private_key
tools.description: Set your TRON private key for this session. Address is derived automatically. Enables write tools: transfer_trx, transfer_trc20, approve_trc20, execute_swap, deposit_trx. Key stays in the MCP process; when using a hosted MCP server, that server receives the key.

private_key.description: Your TRON private key (64 hex characters)

tools.name: deposit_trx
tools.description: Send a plain TRX transfer to your personal Merx deposit address. No memo is required. Broadcast acceptance does not mean the deposit is credited. Requires MERX_API_KEY + TRON_PRIVATE_KEY.

tools.name: enable_auto_deposit
tools.description: Automatic top-up is unavailable. This compatibility tool returns an error without configuring monitoring or sending funds. Check get_balance and use get_deposit_info or an explicitly requested deposit_trx for manual funding.

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Unavailable legacy resource-invoice payment. No transaction is sent. Fund your personal Merx account and use quoted resource orders instead.

tools.name: create_paid_order
tools.description: Unavailable legacy resource-invoice order. No transaction is sent. Fund your personal Merx account and use quoted resource orders instead.

tools.name: execute_intent
tools.description: Plan a multi-step operation (transfer, swap, buy resources, etc) and return a cost estimate, total energy/bandwidth needed, and the cheapest resource acquisition strategy. NOTE: actual on-chain execution of multi-step intents is not yet wired up — currently returns the same plan as simulate, regardless of dry_run. Use this for planning; for real execution call the underlying tools (create_order, transfer_trc20, execute_swap) yourself in sequence. Auth required.

steps.description: Array of { action, params } steps to execute.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate only without executing (default: false).

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Dry-run a multi-step operation (transfer, swap, buy resources, etc) without sending anything on-chain. Returns per-step energy and bandwidth estimates plus a total TRX cost. Use this to preview a plan before committing — for example, before transferring USDT to multiple recipients you can simulate to see the total energy cost. No auth required.

steps.description: Array of { action, params } steps to simulate.

tools.name: create_standing_order
tools.description: Create a server-side standing order with trigger-based automation. Auth required.

trigger_params.description: Trigger parameters: { resource, threshold_sun } or { cron }.

action_params.description: Action parameters: { resource_type, amount, duration_sec, target_address }.

budget_trx.description: Maximum budget in TRX (converted to SUN internally).

max_executions.description: Maximum number of times this order can execute.

tools.name: list_standing_orders
tools.description: List all standing orders with optional status filter. Auth required.

tools.name: get_standing_order
tools.description: Get full details of a single standing order by its UUID. Returns trigger config, action params, budget, executions count, and status. Auth required (API key).

tools.name: cancel_standing_order
tools.description: Cancel a standing order by its UUID. The order is moved to CANCELLED status and will not trigger again. Already-executed actions are NOT reversed. Auth required (API key).

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a persistent server-side monitor that fires notifications when a condition is met. Four monitor types: delegation_expiry (warns when leased energy is about to expire so you can re-rent), balance_threshold (fires when an address goes below a TRX/USDT level), price_alert (fires when energy/bandwidth price crosses a SUN threshold), address_activity (fires on any incoming TX). Notification defaults to webhook=true if omitted. Auth required (API key).

target_address.description: TRON address to monitor. Required for delegation_expiry, balance_threshold, address_activity. Not used for price_alert.

params.description: Type-specific params. delegation_expiry: { alert_before_sec, auto_renew, resource_type }. balance_threshold: { resource: "TRX"|"ENERGY"|"BANDWIDTH", below: number }. price_alert: { resource: "ENERGY"|"BANDWIDTH", above_sun?: number, below_sun?: number }. address_activity: { min_amount_trx?: number }.

notify.description: Notification config: { webhook?: boolean, telegram_chat_id?: string }. Defaults to { webhook: true } if omitted.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List all monitors you created with create_monitor, optionally filtered by status (ACTIVE/CANCELLED). Each row shows the full monitor UUID (pass to cancel_monitor), monitor type, target address, and status. Note: the Target column will be empty for monitor types that do not have a single watched address — specifically price_alert and balance_threshold (when watching the API key holder rather than a third-party address). For delegation_expiry and address_activity monitors, Target will always be set. Auth required (API key).

tools.name: cancel_monitor
tools.description: Cancel an active monitor by its UUID. The monitor stops firing notifications. Auth required (API key).

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw TRX or USDT from your Merx account to an external TRON address. The "amount" parameter is interpreted in the currency specified by "currency" — i.e. for currency=TRX it is TRX units, for currency=USDT it is USDT units. (The legacy parameter "amount_trx" is still accepted as an alias for backwards compatibility, but is misleading when currency is USDT — prefer "amount" in new code.) Requires MERX_API_KEY.

amount.description: Amount to withdraw, in units of the chosen currency. E.g. "100" with currency=TRX = 100 TRX, "100" with currency=USDT = 100 USDT.

amount_trx.description: DEPRECATED alias for "amount" — kept for backwards compatibility. Pass "amount" instead in new code.

tools.name: compile_policy
tools.description:
Convert a natural language energy management policy into MERX automation. Creates standing orders and monitors based on your instructions.

Examples:
- "Keep 500k energy on my wallet, buy when price is below 55 SUN, max 200 TRX/week"
- "Buy energy every day at 6 AM UTC, 1 million units, for 24 hours"
- "Alert me when my energy drops below 100k"

Returns a preview of what will be created. Set apply=true to execute.

instruction.description: Natural language description of the desired automation policy

address.description: TRON address this policy applies to (optional)

apply.description: Set to true to create the standing orders. Default false (preview only).

tools.name: resource_broadcast
tools.description:
Broadcast a signed TRON transaction with automatic energy optimization.
If the target address lacks sufficient energy, MERX purchases the deficit at the best
market price before broadcasting. One call: estimate, buy energy, wait for delegation, broadcast.

Requires MERX_API_KEY with the "broadcast" scope, and a pre-signed transaction.
Returns txid on success, refunds on timeout.

NOTE: This endpoint is currently behind a feature flag and disabled by default in production.
If you get a 503 MAINTENANCE error, use the manual flow instead: call ensure_resources to
provision energy, then sign and broadcast the transaction with your own TronWeb client.

target_address.description: TRON address that will execute the transaction (must match TX sender)

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register your TRON address as an agent on agent.merx.exchange. Required ONCE before using request_payment, create_invoice, watch_address, agent_status, or any other agent payment tool. Pass the TRON address you want to use as the on-chain identity for this API key. Idempotent — calling twice with the same key returns the existing registration. Auth required (API key).

tron_address.description: Your TRON address (T...) that will receive payments and act as the agent identity.

tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Create a TRC20 payment request on TRON (USDT, USDC, USDD, or any TRC20). Returns a payment address. Fires webhook when payment arrives (<3 seconds). Use for receiving payments from other agents or humans. Requires agent registration first — call register_agent if you get AGENT_NOT_REGISTERED error.

tools.name: lookup_invoice
tools.description: Look up a MERX invoice. Shows amount, recipient, token, and status. Agent must sign and broadcast the transfer separately (non-custodial).

invoice_id.description: Invoice UUID (e.g. eaa00c4e-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678) returned by create_invoice, or a full payment URL containing /pay/<uuid>.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for another agent or human to pay. Returns payment URL, address, and QR code. Payment is detected automatically via ZeroMQ (<3 seconds).

tools.name: watch_address
tools.description: Watch any TRON address for TRC20 transfers (USDT, USDC, USDD, or any token). Fires webhook on each matching transfer. Persistent - runs 24/7 even when conversation ends.

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Get a snapshot of your agent payment service: registered TRON address, count of pending payment requests (request_payment), active address watches (watch_address), and outstanding invoices (create_invoice). Use this right after register_agent to confirm the agent is set up, or any time you want to see how much in-flight activity your agent has. Auth required (API key) and agent must be registered first via register_agent.
